:::{#hero-heading}
Hi! I'm Jordan, an SMU graduate in Finance and Data Science & Analytics, currently learning about market microstructure and volatility modelling.

This site is my notebook: the books I read, the films I watch, research notes on markets, and the projects I build along the way. Outside of that I boulder, play badminton, run and play the guitar.
